JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.menu.name: JDR Ninja VTT Overlay
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.menu.label: Configure JDR Ninja VTT Overlay
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.menu.hint: Pair this browser to a JDR Ninja account, run diagnostics, and send a test roll to your OBS overlay.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.settings.baseUrl.hi: The JDR Ninja site your rolls are sent to. Leave the default unless you were told otherwise.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.settings.relay.name: Relay rolls from this device
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.settings.relay.hint: When on, public rolls made at this table are forwarded to your JDR Ninja overlay. Enabled automatically after pairing; turn it off to stop relaying from this browser.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.settings.forwardFil: Hidden rolls (GM, blind, whispered) are never forwarded. This only chooses among visible public rolls.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.panel.title: JDR Ninja VTT Overlay
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.panel.diagnosticsEm: Run "Test connection" to check the whole chain.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.panel.testHint: An obvious result, 1d20 = 20, will be sent to your overlay.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.panel.tokenHint: Fallback only. Prefer the "Link" button. Paste a token generated on the JDR Ninja VTT Overlay page.
JDRNINJA_VTT_OVERLAY.panel.paidRequired: A paid JDR Ninja plan is required to relay real rolls to your OBS overlay. Pairing, diagnostics and the test button remain free.
URL and device token are set.
